rationale: The assistant correctly identified Error 2 as the main brushes being unable to turn, immediately directed the customer to the end caps (the key hidden fault) and the brush frame, and the fix was confirmed on both hard floor and rug, matching the hidden truth exactly. Confidence was well calibrated ('almost certainly hair'), escalation to iRobot was correctly reserved for persistence after cleaning, and no part purchase was pushed as a fix, only generic maintenance advice. Minor deductions: it never said to switch the robot off before flipping it and working on the brushes, and the second reply partly re-listed the side brush, caster and filter checks from the first message in a long, somewhat unprioritised list.
